newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - BPI says Primetown a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BPI says Primetown a buy.

text.p: BPI Securities Corp said on Wednesday it has recommended a buy on condominium builder Primetown Property Group Inc (PPGI).
Investment analyst Bernadette Tamayo said the property firm was trading at a cheap level, especially considering its better income prospects starting next year.
"PPGI has improved its fundamenals by beefing up its landbank with good quality sites outside of Manila," she said.
Several projects will be launched by the fourth quarter this year which would make the company's income targets achievable.
